TASK-MIG-001.hash_rule: rolling: migration-state.json is tracked in Git, so a task's own commit cannot embed its own hash. Each task records its predecessor's real hash and leaves its own hash 'pending'; the successor finalizes it. TASK-MIG-002's commit records TASK-MIG-001's real retry-commit hash in this field. TASK-MIG-013's hash is finalized by the final draft-PR-update commit. No false or self-referential hash is ever recorded.

operational_notes.state_tracking: migration-state.json is tracked in Git (no .gitignore entry) as the single durable source of truth. It is excluded from the wheel and sdist via pyproject [tool.uv.build-backend] source-exclude, and tests/test_wheel.py permits only this exact root file under the repository payload rule while still rejecting every other JSON payload and asserting the file's absence from both distributions.
operational_notes.fixture_naming: JSON-content fixtures use the .txt extension (checkpoint.txt, exchange.txt, model_output.txt), matching the repository convention (tests/fixtures/controlled_browser/*.txt) and avoiding the .json payload suffix that archive safety forbids. They still parse via the current checked-in JSON models.
